scene: The sweet tea energizes you as three departing transit gates light up.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view along the market concourse. The player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates stands centre, holding an empty teacup. On the far left sits a pink bullet train with open doors. To the right, a solar junk is tied to a low pier. Up high hangs a glass cable pod.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train with open automated doors on the far left
a moored wooden junk with glowing solar sails at the pier right
a round glass cable pod swaying softly from a rail up high
